title: I Am Odysseus
blurb: Reveal yourself to the court of the Phaeacians. A solo trial for the bold.

characters.name: Odysseus
characters.description: The hero, finally ready to say his own name.

lines.text: I am Odysseus, son of Laertes, renowned among mankind for all manner of subtlety, so that my fame ascends to heaven.
lines.direction: Rise to your full height. Hand on heart.

lines.text: I live in Ithaca, where there is a high mountain called Neritum, covered with forests.
lines.direction: Gaze into the distance, toward home.

lines.text: It is a rugged island, but it breeds brave men, and my eyes know none that they had better look upon.
Now let me tell you of the many hard adventures which by heaven's will I met with on my return from Troy.
lines.direction: Turn to your audience. Arms wide.

source: Homer, The Odyssey, tr. Samuel Butler (public domain), adapted
